contracts.title: F11 protection remains independent of new stores
contracts.review_question: Could a new database, AI or advisory dependency delay or block existing protective operations?

contracts.title: PostgreSQL authority and invalid-config fail closed
contracts.review_question: Do explicit invalid authority, stale epoch and database outages reject new business admissions without affecting protection?

contracts.title: Atomic, idempotent ledger and typed business projections
contracts.review_question: Are transaction atomicity, immutable event identity, SQL grants and concurrent aggregate ordering verified under the restricted app role?

contracts.title: Advisory cannot bypass execution, capacity or funded authority
contracts.review_question: Could malformed evidence, new entry code or mode drift bypass funded-execution and actionable-only safety boundaries?

contracts.title: Exactly one authoritative new-record storage path
contracts.review_question: After an separately approved cutover, are competing file/SQLite writes fenced, without retroactive historic migration?

contracts.title: Delivery telemetry is read-only in observer paths and accurately attributed
contracts.review_question: Can read-only summary mutate state, lose folded counts, misattribute UTC days, or suppress attempts?

contracts.title: Existing PR secrets and release security controls remain intact
contracts.review_question: Were Gitleaks, security gates, authorization checks or scan scopes weakened? A confirmed exposed credential requires immediate rotation.
